rule_origin: Tune-only exploratory rules of prior marked full-document comparison; no refitting or threshold selection on the new corpus. Same rules transferred to all input variants for diagnostic comparison.
annotation_protocol: Source/catalog/target-only blind AI second pass before inference; authored and reviewed labels hashed, disagreements adjudicated without scores. Synthetic source and AI annotation remain disclosed.
limitations: New family synthetic stress test, not independent deployment-distribution audit.
Correlated targets, documents and shared templates are not independent binomial trials.
Fixed complete two-candidate catalog does not evaluate production retrieval or mention detection.
One scoring repeat measures throughput, not determinism.
Structural paths stay separate from semantic abstention evidence.
